decisions.reason: The Table-of-Contents review is already captured by its own same-message INTRODUCE Event; expanding chapter-heading scope requires no additional candidate-state change.
Reviewing chapter titles and subtitles does not change the established italic and quotation-mark treatment for Mama's Hot Take sections.
The page-number instruction is already captured by a separate same-message MODIFY, while the chapter-heading scope expansion does not alter pagination or TOC page-number rules.
Chapter-title and subtitle review does not resume or modify the deferred body-text spacing requirement.
The source scope change concerns headings and subtitles, not justified alignment of body text.
Reviewing chapter headings and subtitles does not change the paperback publication format or 6 x 9 inch trim size.
The source decision changes typography scope and does not alter image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The reference to all chapters concerns title and subtitle typography, not chapter-image coverage, placement, or presentation.
The typography scope expansion does not change illustration suitability, source, or review criteria.
Chapter-title formatting review does not alter the constraint excluding unintended newline-marker text from the book title.
The chapter-heading and subtitle scope change does not affect copyright-page alignment.
The source Event concerns chapter-heading typography; it does not resolve or modify the separate cover-design preference and ambiguity.
